MPSC Mains Result 2026 has been released on 25th August 2026 for the MPSC State Services Main Examination 2025. Maharashtra Public Service Commission (MPSC) has published the List of Qualified Candidates under Advertisement No. 001/2026. The MPSC Mains result PDF is out with roll numbers and names of candidates who qualified in MPSC Rajyaseva Mains examination. A total of 438 candidates are mentioned as qualified. The Prelims was conducted on 9th November 2025, while the Mains examination was held on 5th April, 18th April, 19th April, 26th April and 2nd May 2026.

The MPSC Rajyaseva 2025 recruitment was released with 385 vacancies, which later revised to 601 posts across State Services, Maharashtra Forest Services, Maharashtra Civil Engineering Service and Maharashtra Electrical Engineering Service. Candidates can download the MPSC Rajyaseva Main Result PDF and use their roll number to check their qualifying status.

MPSC Mains Result 2025-26 PDF – Click to Download

MPSC Rajyaseva Mains Result 2026 Out

MPSC has released the Rajyaseva Mains Result 2026 in the form of a List of Qualified Candidates. The uploaded PDF is titled “LIST OF QUALIFIED CANDIDATES” and identifies the examination as the State Services Main Examination – 2025 under Advertisement No. 001/2026. The centre-wise lists contain 438 qualified candidates.

The PDF provides the roll number and candidate name along with the examination centre. Candidates can therefore check their qualification status directly from the list without waiting for an individual result PDF. The result PDF covers candidates from the following centres:

  • Amravati
  • Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar
  • Nagpur
  • Nashik
  • Navi Mumbai
  • Pune

MPSC Mains Result 2026 Overview

The MPSC Mains Result 2026 is available as a list of qualified candidates for the State Services Main Examination 2025. The result is published under Advertisement No. 001/2026 and is dated 25th August 2026.

How to Download MPSC Rajyaseva Main Result PDF?

Candidates can download MPSC Rajyaseva Main Result PDF from official MPSC website and search for their roll number in the qualified list. The official MPSC website maintains a dedicated Results section for examination results.

  1. Visit the official MPSC website.
  2. Go to the Results section.
  3. Find the result notice for State Services Main Examination 2025.
  4. Check Advertisement No. 001/2026.
  5. Open the List of Qualified Candidates PDF.
  6. Download the PDF.
  7. Press Ctrl + F on your computer.
  8. Enter your roll number.
  9. Check your name and qualification status.
  10. Save the PDF for future reference.

Details Mentioned in MPSC Mains Result PDF

MPSC Mains Result PDF highlights basic identification details of candidates required to check qualification status. The centre-wise lists provide the candidate’s serial number, roll number and name. The PDF includes:

  • Advertisement number
  • Examination name
  • Examination date of result publication
  • Examination centre
  • Serial number
  • Roll number
  • Candidate’s name
  • Number of qualified candidates at each centre
  • Cut-off marks

MPSC Mains Cut Off 2026

The MPSC Rajyaseva Mains Result PDF also contains cut-off marks for different categories and sub-categories. The final page is headed “CUTOFF” and is linked to Advertisement No. 001/2026 and the State Services Main Examination 2025. The PDF contains category/sub-category headings including Unreserved, SC, ST, OBC, EWS, SEBC, NT, SBC and Divyang, along with general, female and other applicable classifications.

MPSC Rajyaseva 2025-26 Revised Vacancy

The MPSC Rajyaseva 2025 vacancy was increased from the initially announced 385 posts to 601 posts. The revised vacancies cover four service groups.

Service Revised Vacancy
MPSC State Services 150
Maharashtra Forest Services 144
Maharashtra Civil Engineering Service 296
Maharashtra Electrical Engineering Service 11
Total 601

These vacancy figures relate to the Rajyaseva 2025 recruitment cycle and should not be confused with the number of candidates qualified in the Mains result PDF.

MPSC Rajyaseva 2025-26 Important Dates

The MPSC Rajyaseva 2025 recruitment process began with the notification released on 18th March 2025. Applications were active from 28th March to 17th April 2025, followed by the Preliminary Examination in November 2025 and the Main Examination in April-May 2026.

MPSC Mains Result 2026 FAQs

When was the MPSC Rajyaseva Mains Result 2026 released?

The MPSC Rajyaseva Mains Result 2026 was released on 25 August 2026 for the State Services Main Examination 2025. The result PDF is published under Advertisement No. 001/2026.

What is the MPSC Rajyaseva Mains Result PDF?

The MPSC Rajyaseva Mains Result PDF is the List of Qualified Candidates for the State Services Main Examination 2025. It provides candidate roll numbers and names arranged according to examination centre.

What was the revised MPSC Rajyaseva 2025 vacancy?

The MPSC Rajyaseva 2025 vacancy was revised from the initial 385 posts to 601 posts, covering State Services, Forest Services, Civil Engineering Service and Electrical Engineering Service.

Where can I check the MPSC Mains Result 2026?

Candidates can check the result through the official MPSC Results section and download the qualified candidates PDF. The Commission maintains a dedicated results page for examination and recruitment results.

What information is available in the MPSC Rajyaseva result PDF?

The PDF provides the examination name, advertisement number, examination centre, candidate serial number, roll number and candidate name. It also includes centre-wise candidate counts and cut-off information.
